digest.component_or_area: rebar init command and store initialization
propositions: rebar init must not create an orphan divergent store when the configured tickets branch fetch fails or the remote is unreachable

a tri-state remote-branch probe using git ls-remote must distinguish advertised (return 0), reachable-but-absent (return 2), and unreachable-or-timeout (return 124) states, consumed by _mount_or_create_branch, pending_init_attaches_to_existing, ensure_store_mounted_best_effort, and _create_tracker

unreachable or timing-out remotes must fail closed with actionable diagnostics naming the remote, branch, and timeout; strict auto-init must not enter the consent prompt; best-effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount and return without error

an explicit --force-new-store CLI flag or force_new_store=True library keyword must permit deliberate bootstrap only when reachability cannot be established; when remote is reachable, the override is ineffective and a warning is emitted

the advertisement probe must be cached by short TTL per resolved repo/remote/branch to limit probing to at most one per CLI invocation; ensure_store_mounted_best_effort and the following strict path reuse the cached result

reachable-absent branches must still bootstrap successfully as legitimate first-init orphans; advertised branches must attempt bounded fetch and mount only after materialization or fail nonzero without orphaning
